text.aria-label: Title text 'Primary D12, scan-found, no NGED label (experiment 456): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-12 fit. Mean absolute error of the median during the event, points of capacity: lagless 21.2, S1 14.7, B-mix 17.1, K2-S1 15.8. Middle: the three lags the networks read. Bottom: each lag minus the lagless median at its half-hour (S1's surprise). The event may be a load shift, a level change, or neither.'
text.tspan: Primary D12, scan-found, no NGED label (experiment 456): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-12 fit.
Mean absolute error of the median during the event, points of capacity: lagless 21.2, S1 14.7, B-mix 17.1, K2-S1 15.8.
Middle: the three lags the networks read. Bottom: each lag minus the lagless median at its half-hour (S1's surprise).
The event may be a load shift, a level change, or neither.
